summary: Getting started: install Ansible with pip and create a single project folder (ansible_quickstart) to hold your automation, which makes source control and sharing easier.
questions: What's the quickest way to start using Ansible?
How should I organize my first Ansible project?

answer_card.title: Start an Ansible project
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
pip install ansible
mkdir ansible_quickstart && cd ansible_quickstart
```
Keeping everything in one directory makes it easy to put under source control and to reuse or share. Next step: build an inventory.
